name: Genius Lyrics
description: Search Genius for Christian and worship song lyrics and import them into your song library as formatted slides.

permissions.reason: Appears as a panel in the console
Searches Genius and downloads the lyrics page for a song you pick (the server makes these requests, only to these hosts)
Adds the imported song to your song library
Adds the imported song to the schedule, and goes live for "Import & Go Live"
